title: NirDiamant/agents-towards-production turns agent prototypes into deployable systems
friendlyTitle: A practical guide helps turn AI agent demos into real products
summary: Agents Towards Production is a 21,000-star collection of code-first tutorials spanning stateful workflows, memory, browser automation, APIs, containers, security, evaluation, observability and multi-agent coordination. The repository appeared on today’s GitHub trend scan and packages the material as a path from prototype to deployment.
friendlySummary: This popular repository collects working lessons about memory, security, testing, monitoring, deployment and multi-agent systems. It focuses on what an agent needs after the first demo works.
whyItMatters: Builders can use individual tutorials to add production concerns to an existing agent rather than adopting one large framework. Its examples are especially useful as a checklist for the reliability, security and monitoring work that begins after a demo succeeds.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Choose the tutorial that matches the next problem in your project. The collection is also a useful checklist for features that make an agent safer and more reliable.
